self_tests.verifies: this gate reports a surviving mutation instead of a pass

mutations.name: a-green-self-test-counted-as-a-kill
mutations.find:
if code == 0:
                report.survived(entry, mutation, "the self-test still passed")
mutations.replace:
if False:
                report.survived(entry, mutation, "the self-test still passed")
mutations.expect: FAIL  a mutation that leaves the self-test green is reported as survived

mutations.name: a-failure-that-names-nothing-counted-as-a-kill
mutations.expect: FAIL  a self-test that fails without naming the assertion is reported as survived

mutations.name: a-stale-mutation-counted-as-a-kill
mutations.expect: FAIL  a mutation whose find no longer matches is reported as stale

mutations.name: a-red-baseline-mutated-anyway
mutations.expect: FAIL  a self-test that is already red is reported instead of mutated

mutations.name: mutations-not-restored-between-runs
mutations.expect: FAIL  every mutation is restored before the next one
